column1: #   tier          one of: common, uncommon, rare, ultra_rare
#   weight        positive integer, relative weight *within this tier only*.
#                 All entries below use 1, i.e. every Pokemon in a tier is
#                 equally likely - raise an entry's weight to favour it over
#                 its tier-mates without touching the others.
#   pokeget-args  passed straight through to pokeget, unquoted/word-split -
#                 an entry may carry extra flags, e.g. "rotom --form wash".
#                 Because of the word split, no name or flag value here can
#                 contain a literal space *within* one argument.
